title: Ember-AI environment configuration
description: Schema for the Ember-AI .env file (see .env.example). Validated by tests/test-compose.sh.

BIND_ADDRESS.description: Docker01 LAN interface to bind published ports to; keep off the internet (Cloudflare tunnel fronts it).

LITELLM_PORT.description: Host port for the LiteLLM gateway.

EMBER_DASHBOARD_PORT.description: Host port for the Ember dashboard.

EMBER_API_PORT.description: Host port for the Ember API.

QDRANT_PORT.description: Host port for Qdrant (qdrant profile only).

LLM_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL for the LLM gateway, fronted by the Cloudflare tunnel.

LLM_INTERNAL_URL.description: Internal LAN URL for the LLM gateway.

EMBER_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL for the Ember dashboard/control plane.

OMLX_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL for the oMLX inference server.

OMLX_HOST.description: LAN host/IP of oMLX, running on jons-mac-mini.

OMLX_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the oMLX inference server on the LAN.

OMLX_API_KEY.description: API key for authenticating to oMLX.

OMLX_CHAT_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for general chat completions.

OMLX_FAST_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for low-latency/fast completions.

OMLX_CODE_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for code-oriented completions.

OMLX_VISION_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for vision-capable completions.

OMLX_EMBED_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for embeddings.

OMLX_STT_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for speech-to-text.

OMLX_TTS_MODEL.description: oMLX model id used for text-to-speech.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: API key for authenticating to OpenRouter (cloud fallback provider).

OPENROUTER_THINK_MODEL.description: OpenRouter model id used for the 'think' cloud route.

LITELLM_MASTER_KEY.description: Master key for the LiteLLM gateway admin/API access.

LITELLM_DB_PASSWORD.description: Password for the litellm-postgres database user.

LITELLM_TURN_OFF_MESSAGE_LOGGING.description: When true, prompts/responses are not stored in LiteLLM spend logs.

EMBER_API_KEY.description: API key for authenticating to the Ember control-plane API (also read by the dashboard).

EMBER_POLL_INTERVAL_S.description: Polling interval, in seconds, used by the Ember control plane.
